title: Stickney Barrel Factory — Coopers for Potato Growers
description: The small farmer could not exist alone. Entire trades developed around them. Harness makers crafted tack for horses and oxen. Millers ground grain into flour. General stores supplied salt, nails, cloth, and seed. Veterinarians, farriers, loggers, and river drivers all played their roles. For potato growers, coopers built barrels at the Stickney Barrel Factory to ease transport.
